snippet.title: Deathwish Bloom – a hand-drawn romance mystery  – Visual Novel Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In this hand-drawn romance mystery visual novel, play as Sky, a love-struck impostor scientist. Survive your own secrets in a world shattered by earthquakes. Grow closer to characters whose obsessions can both aid and destroy your desperate bid to recreate a cure that only you know existed.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4117810/Deathwish_Bloom/?utm_source=yttrailer
Itch.io: https://sharpglassgames.itch.io/deathwish-bloom
